purpose: harness self-test: the scripted backend replays fixed turns, so these results test the harness, tools, policy and approval path, not a model

definitions.latency: request sent to the backend until its final answer, per run (internal/agent/agent.go Loop.Run); percentiles by nearest rank
definitions.pass: all of: required tools called without error and no forbidden tool called; the expected ApprovalRequest/draft exists and no other write exists; refusal stated with a reason when expected; every required fact holds in the fixture and is cited as Kind/name, field and value, and every Kind/name in the answer exists (docs/DESIGN.md §4.1, evals/harness/judge.go)
